acp-phpstorm.title: PhpStorm with a throwaway config directory, Unfold's ACP agent against the local demo
acp-phpstorm.result: not possible on this desktop. The installed PhpStorm is 2025.1.1 without the AI Assistant plugin, which is where a custom ACP agent is added, and a throwaway profile has neither a PhpStorm licence nor a JetBrains AI sign-in. Instead `unfold-acp-agent --url` was started against the demo and driven over stdio by hand: `initialize` answered protocol 1 with the terminal sign-in method, `session/new` offered the Ask and Steer modes, and `/now` listed 9 waiting Work Items under the demo label. That is the same path `acp-agent.test.ts` covers, so the editor side stays unproven

vscode-extension.title: VS Code with a throwaway user-data-dir and the packaged VSIX
vscode-extension.result: VS Code 1.143.1 installed `unfold-0.4.0-rc.114.vsix` from `npm run extension:package`. The extension activated on startup and registered its commands, the activity bar showed 7 waiting items from the demo, and the status bar said the Agents window was not connected. GitHub authentication and Copilot Chat were turned off for this run

vscode-agents-window.title: VS Code's Agents window attached to the local demo over AHP
vscode-agents-window.result: VS Code 1.143.1 started with `--agents` and a `chat.remoteAgentHosts` entry from `POST /api/agent-host/tokens`. It initialized in 120 ms on AHP 1.0.0, registered the `unfold` and `unfold-chat` agents, and subscribed to automations, sessions, chats and terminals; `GET /api/agent-host` listed it as `vscode-agents-window`. VS Code asked the host for `createResourceWatch`, which Unfold does not implement (-32601), and for folders outside the repositories, which Unfold refuses (-32008). With `chat.agentHost.allowSignedOutWhenUsable` set, the window still started a GitHub sign-in on its own, which went through the desktop's browser

One Agents window session that starts a real Run on a bronze Team and opens its pull request
